name: setWindowDragRegions
description: Report the nexus topbar's OS window-drag map. The React topbar lives in the guest <webview>, so its `-webkit-app-region` never reaches the host frame; it instead measures its draggable bar + no-drag control rects and sends them here. C++ ORs them into CustomBrowserWebUIView::IsInWebUIDragRegion so the frameless window drags from the bar. Payload: { regions: [{x,y,width,height,draggable}] } in guest-viewport CSS px (the topbar sits at the view origin).
